Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 33

“Even a person of knowledge acts according to their own nature. Beings follow their nature — what will restraint accomplish?”

A candid limit on the power of resolve, and it comes from Krishna rather than a skeptic. Nature is not overruled by suppression, which is why the next verse looks elsewhere.
